title: Three companies, one ISP
description: A reference with three ways to build a site: router-on-a-stick, redundant uplinks with one unmanaged switch per VLAN, and untagged LANs on router ports. Plus a point-to-point cable and an IPsec tunnel. Illustrative values only.

title: Minimal: one site, two VLANs
description: The smallest useful plan. Both subnets are auto-allocated.
